domain: multilateral development bank operations / project lifecycle panel
prediction_question: At the board-approval instant of an African Development Bank Group (AfDB) operation, using only the at-approval attributes AfDB publishes in its IATI activity files (country, sector, financing instrument, commitment, planned span, era), will the operation ultimately be CANCELLED (activity-status 5) rather than COMPLETED (activity-status 3)?
prediction_time: The instant the operation enters AfDB's published record at approval: activity-date type 1 (planned start), observed within ~1 day of MapAfrica's displayed 'Approval Date' (P-KE-KF0-013: UI 23 Sept 2026 vs API planned_start 2026-09-24; a bounded construction sample must pin this offset). All features are at-approval attributes; the terminal status is observed only years later at the current coverage end (registry files re-published in full, so the current vintage is the observation frame - a current-vintage retrospective task, not an operational historical claim).
target_definition: Binary: terminal activity-status = Cancelled (IATI code 5) vs Completed (code 3) for operations whose outcome window has closed. Label source column: activity-status in AfDB's IATI XML (excludable by construction - it ships only as the label). Statuses 1 (Approved, 383) and 2 (Ongoing, 987) are right-censored and never scored; eligibility must be defined from information available at the instant (approval date + planned end + censoring margin), never from eventual status.

split_strategy: Temporal split on approval year (activity-date type 1), chosen 2026-11-05 from the measured registry-XML table and PRE-REGISTERED before any construction or score: train approvals <=2000 (1,871 terminal rows / 121 cancelled positives / 107 country-year cells / 6.47%); eval 2001-2011 (1,126 / 32 / 27-29 cells / 2.84%); holdout 2012-2023 (1,087 / 38 / 31 cells / 3.50% - CORRECTED 2026-11-05 from the pinned-vintage per-year table and confirmed by the build: the original 1,118/3.40% subtracted 2012's 110 rows instead of 2011's 141; the pre-registered windows and the 38 positives were always correct). 2024+ approvals (4 terminal rows, 0 positives) and all right-censored statuses 1/2 (1,100 rows, approvals 2007+) are excluded and declared. The eval end was extended from 2010 to 2011 because the originally proposed eval window carried 29 positives, one short of the gate's 30-positive minimum; the re-cut is measured, not tuned - no score exists. Positives cluster by country and approval year (clustered share in cells with >=2 positives: 26/121 train, 6/29 eval, 12/41 holdout); the cluster/event key is country-or-region x approval year, declared to the gate as positive_events.

measurements.xml_field_inventory_2026_11_04: Per-activity fields available at approval in the registry XML: iati-identifier, title, recipient-country, sector (vocabulary 1), activity-date types 1-3, default-flow-type (10=ODA), default-finance-type (421/110 on 35/42 in the sample), default-tied-status (5=untied), conditions attached, budget items with AfDB-specific codes, participating organisations (2,073 distinct across the bank per MapAfrica stats). Post-approval / label-source fields excluded from features: activity-date type 4 (actual end), activity-status, transaction histories (2,442 transaction elements in the sample file carrying afdb:finance-type-id), total_disbursements. No explicit board-approval-date element exists in the XML; the type-1 date is the instant proxy (see prediction_time).

measurements.novelty_search_2026_11_04: Web searches found no published, scored or ML-ready benchmark for AfDB operation outcomes: nearest prior art is a Nature Energy 2020 ML study predicting realization of PLANNED POWER PLANTS in Africa (different population - all power plants, not AfDB operations), MOPAN institutional assessment reports (descriptive), and an unrelated HuggingFace IATI mirror of Malaysia aid flows (country-level aggregates, no outcome task). The WB-family comparators on this bench (wb-ieg-project-outcome, wb-loan-disbursement-completion) were dropped on measured no-headroom over identity/rate priors at the Board-approval instant - this candidate's differentiation must be measured against that precedent, not assumed (see next_action).

novelty_check.theirs: AfDB publishes raw IATI activity XML (57 registry datasets, CC BY 4.0) and MapAfrica aggregates (activity counts by status, no splits, no contract); the ML-for-development literature predicts World Bank project performance from IEG outcome ratings (different publisher, different label - rating levels, not cancellation - and different population); Chinese-vs-WB remote-sensing studies measure local wealth gains, not operation terminal status.
novelty_check.ours: A scored, split, frozen prediction task at AfDB operation grain: at-approval features drawn from AfDB's own IATI 2.03 activity files (country, sector, financing instrument, commitment, planned span, era), terminal cancellation label (activity-status 5 vs 3), temporal splits by approval year with an explicit right-censoring rule, and a pre-registered country/sector/decade rate-triad reference check. No public ML-ready dataset or benchmark exists for AfDB operation outcomes; the publisher ships raw activity files and dashboard aggregates only.
novelty_check.rule: A dataset that already exists in ML-ready form is not published. Mirroring is a failure mode, not a contribution.

rejection_reason: Measured no headroom over the identity prior at the board-approval instant, under the pre-registered deciding check. The full model (harness runner baseline, xgboost, eval AUC 0.6394 on the identical 1,126 eval rows) beats the trailing sector-x-decade rate (0.4697) with a cluster-aware paired bootstrap CI of [+0.0124, +0.3231] and the degenerate global rate (model AUC CI [0.5354, 0.7480] entirely above 0.5), but does NOT beat the strongest member, the trailing country rate (0.5491): model-minus-prior CI [-0.0765, +0.2546] contains zero, so the observed +0.0903 gap is inconclusive, not a demonstrated margin. Per the rule written before any score ('headroom is demonstrated ONLY if the full model beats EVERY triad member with a cluster-aware bootstrap 95% CI excluding zero in the model's favour'), headroom is NOT demonstrated and the candidate drops with the evidence preserved - the third measured instance of the WB at-approval family defect (after wb-ieg-project-outcome and wb-loan-disbursement-completion). The negative finding does not prove every competent model must lose: eval carries only 29 independent positive event cells (country-or-region x approval year), and the cluster-aware interval is wide precisely because the positives are that clustered.
